Jemes A. Timmermen, Jr., Ph.D. Executive Director Jefferson C. Fuller, Jr. Director of Geme and Freshwater Fisheries
P. O. Box 1645 Clemson, S. C. 29631
21 June 1976
Mr. Daniel H. Smalley Federal Power Commission 825 North Capitol Street Washington, D. C. 20426
Dear Mr. Smalley:
As indicated during our telephone conversation of June 11, 1976, I am enclosing a corrected copy of the graph depicting temperature (°C) profiles at the Jocassee Dam - September for 1973, 1974 and 1975. As discussed the lower limit of trout habitat using 5.0 mg/l for the year 1973 would be at 34 meters rather than 50 meters.
No comment required.
Please replace the original copy with the one enclosed.
Sincerely,
Randy Geddings; Fisheries Biologist
